context: Class wraps up its discussion of the criminal case with a moral takeaway
purpose: Teach: 刑事/殺し/侵害/違法/正当/権限/戦闘/馬鹿

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: では、今日の刑事事件の議論をまとめましょう。被告は殺しの容疑で起訴されましたね。
lines.en: Well then, let's wrap up today's discussion of the criminal case. The defendant was indicted on murder charges, right?
lines.style: composed teacher transitioning into a structured summary tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、彼の弁護士は正当防衛だって主張してましたよね。
lines.en: Sensei, his lawyer was arguing it was legitimate self-defense, wasn't he?
lines.style: thoughtful university student pressing a legal nuance carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもさ、相手が倒れた後も殴り続けたんでしょ?それってもう喧嘩じゃなくて戦闘って感じじゃん。
lines.en: But like, he kept hitting the guy even after he was down, right? That's not a fight anymore, that's straight-up combat.
lines.style: blunt teenage girl pushing back with casual indignation

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい視点ですね。警察にも逮捕する権限はありますが、市民が私的に裁くのは違法です。
lines.en: A good point. The police have the authority to arrest, but for a private citizen to mete out justice is illegal.
lines.style: measured teacher affirming a student while steering the lesson

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: つまり、たとえ怒っていても他人の人権を侵害する権利はないってことですか。
lines.en: So even if you're angry, you don't have the right to violate another person's human rights?
lines.style: earnest student tying the concept back to first principles

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そう考えると、感情だけで動くのって馬鹿げてるよね…ちょっと反省した。
lines.en: When you put it that way, acting on emotion alone is just stupid... I feel a bit chastened.
lines.style: teen softening from sass to quiet self-reflection mid-sentence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうです。今日の教訓は、正義と暴力の境界をきちんと考えることですよ。
lines.en: Exactly. Today's lesson is to think carefully about the line between justice and violence.
lines.style: warm teacher closing the lesson with deliberate moral weight
